steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Ah, the old sheriff was living a comfortable life before everything went downhill, it seems.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Look at the walls, the chandelier, the ceiling...

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Sigh... I wonder what got into his head. A respectable sheriff spending so much time in a casino and ending up with these lowlifes on his tail...
The masked man kicks one of the debt collectors who were shot and are lying on the floor. Then he turns to the woman tightly bound to a chair.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Do you know, my beautiful lady?
Bang!
A gunshot rings out in the dim room. The bullet embeds itself in the wall. The man wearing the eerie mask freezes for a second.
Don't... don't touch my mom! L-let her go!
The voice belongs to a girl. She has her gun trained on the man, her hand trembling visibly. The woman tied to the chair keeps shaking her head, as if trying to tell the girl not to act rashly.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Oh, how impressive! Just so you know, I'm not as easy to deal with as these debt collectors.
Oliver
The man walks up to the girl leisurely. He bends forward to pick up the casing and squints at it.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: .40 caliber, right? The Eastside Public Security Bureau's standard-issue semi-automatic pistol.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: How many shots did you fire at these idiots? Seven? Eight?

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Counting the one you greeted me with... And now five more... Honestly, it's a bit of a waste.
As he talks, the man removes the bullets from his torso one by one. He takes a long look at them before strolling back to the woman.

The man's skin has an almost metallic sheen where the faint moonlight bounces off it. He places the bullets on the woman's upturned palm and squints sideways at the girl who somehow escaped being tied up by the debt collectors.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: You have a very talented daughter.

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: Leave her alone! Take anything you want! Just leave her alone!

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: That wouldn't be necessary, madam. The things in this house weren't good enough for these debt collectors. You don't really think the leader of the <color=#fb9259>Ghosts</color> are none the wiser, do you?

steps.speaker: Woman
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Ghosts</color>?!
The woman's face turns paler, a study in fear. The bullets fall from her hand onto the floor.
The man wearing the grotesque mask grabs the barrel of the gun in the girl's hand and presses the muzzle tightly against his forehead.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Come on, shoot!

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: We're birds of a feather. You shouldn't waste your talents here.
The girl's face is dripping with tears mingled with sweat. She tries to let go of the gun, but the man stops her, pinning her hand to the grip.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Shoot, or I'll destroy everything you hold dear, one by one.

steps.speaker: Masked Man
steps.content: Come on, shoot!
Scene change

steps.speaker: Team Member A
steps.content: The Corruptor is right in front of you! Don't just stand there!
The sound of gunfire and her teammates' roars snap the girl out of her daze. She refocuses her eyes on the monster not far away.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Roooar!

steps.speaker: Team Member A
steps.content: It's coming again. Stop shooting and fan out!
Upon receiving the teammate's instructions, the girl reacts instinctively.
She sidesteps to avoid the monster's pounce, rolls behind it. She steadies herself, and trains her gun on it, ready to shoot.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Roooar!
The monster pounces again, its claws slicing through the air, creating an air current.
The girl pulls the trigger. An explosive sound. A specially-made bullet hits the monster's midriff. She reloads and approaches the monster.
The Corruptor, harassed by the humans, becomes even more berserk. It raises its arms high and brings them down on the ground.
A thick cloud of dust rises. Rocks fly every which way. And then there is silence all around. Thinking that most of the pests have met their demise, the monster feels pleased with itself.

steps.speaker: Corruptor
steps.content: Ha!
The monster shakes its body, as if in celebration of its victory over the humans. It makes to eliminate those who are still alive...

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Letting your guard down on the battlefield is a fatal mistake.
The girl bursts out of the curtain of smoke, charging at the monster, and leaps into the air when it is close.
She trains the gun on the monster's head, her body curving into the shape of a bow.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Disappear!
She is about to pull the trigger to kill the monster when she notices how its entire body gleams faintly.
It reminds her of the invincible evil being that appeared out of nowhere on that fateful night.
The monster takes advantage of the girl's lapse of concentration and swings at her. The blow comes so fast that she has no time to react. It connects and sends her flying.
My spine will probably hit a nearby building and shatter to pieces, she thinks as she is hurtling through the air.

steps.speaker: Team Member B
steps.content: Jane, are you okay?! Jane, do you copy?
Her teammate's voice over the radio, the howling of the wind, the Corruptor's roars... they blend together, growing fainter and fainter.
It wouldn't be so bad to die like this. There would be compensation. The money could be used to pay for Mom's treatment.
This could be a way to free me from that nightmare.
T-thank goodness we made it...
Don't misuse the shackles... The Undertakers save no man.
Her hearing is back. She's still alive. The excruciating pain in her shoulder is proof enough.
She can hear voices, very close to her. Two voices? They seem to be arguing...
She opens her eyes. A man in gray is standing in front of her, with a chain of crimson thorns extending from his hand. And the other end of the chain is connected to a girl wielding a giant chainsaw.
steps.female_content: She opens her eyes. A woman in gray is standing in front of her, with a chain of crimson thorns extending from her hand. And the other end of the chain is connected to a girl wielding a giant chainsaw.

steps.content: The person clad in gray quickly approaches the girl who has just regained consciousness to check on her.

steps.speaker: Person In Gray
steps.content: You've done enough. To hold the Corruptor back for as long as you did under such circumstances... You're an exceptional sheriff.

steps.speaker: Person In Gray
steps.content: I'll take it from here.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Cough... Thanks...
She makes to get up but is stopped by a restraining hand.

steps.speaker: Person In Gray
steps.content: You need to rest. The medical team is coming. Please allow me to give you first aid. To stop the bleeding.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: All right...
The good Samaritan locates the girl's wound and borrows her dagger.

He tears pieces of cloth from his coat with the help of the dagger, places one of them on the girl's wound, and ties the rest around it. Then he snaps a twig off a nearby bush, threads it between the two layers of cloth, and twists it to exert more pressure on the wound.
steps.female_content: She tears pieces of cloth from her coat with the help of the dagger, places one of them on the girl's wound, and ties the rest around it. Then she snaps a twig off a nearby bush, threads it between the two layers of cloth, and twists it to exert more pressure on the wound.

steps.speaker: Person In Gray
steps.content: You hang in there. It'll be over soon. Don't close your eyes. You must stay conscious.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Okay...
She nods ever so slightly, her teeth clenched. Fortunately, the monster's claws didn't hit any artery. The pain is persistent, but the bleeding has stopped, and the dizziness has subsided.

steps.speaker: Framework Against Catastrophe
steps.content: Give the command! Where is the command?
I want to eliminate every Corruptor here!
The Sinner's voice is wild, almost animalistic. She seems to be on the verge of losing control.

steps.speaker: Person In Gray
steps.content: Wendy, eliminate the Corruptor!
The shackles linking the two start glowing white. Upon receiving the order, the girl named Wendy dashes forward in a strange posture, instantly slicing off one of the Corruptor's arms.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Is this...
The girl watches what's unfolding in front of her in amazement. A powerful current of energy flows gently between the two through the shackles.
This person dressed in gray who just saved her life, she is absolutely certain now, is the legendary Chief of the MBCC.
Wendy parries the monster's attack, and spinning, cuts the ugly Corruptor in half with her chainsaw.

steps.speaker: Person In Gray
steps.content: Wendy, eliminate the Corruptor!
The shackles linking the two start glowing white. Upon receiving the order, the girl named Wendy dashes forward in a strange posture, instantly slicing off one of the Corruptor's arms.

steps.content: Is this...
The girl watches what's unfolding in front of her in amazement. A powerful current of energy flows gently between the two through the shackles.
This person dressed in gray who just saved her life, she is absolutely certain now, is the legendary Chief of the MBCC.
Wendy parries the monster's attack, and spinning, cuts the ugly Corruptor in half with her chainsaw.
The moment the top half of the Corruptor hits the ground, the red shackles disappear.
"Great power should be restrained and guided by greater power." She came across this phrase in one of the textbooks used in the sheriff academy.

steps.speaker: Young Girl
steps.content: Will I be able to do this too?

You've changed into fresh clothes. You're now in the Public Security Bureau's cafeteria holding a meal voucher in your hand and standing in line for a free meal. A long line has formed in front of each window. You can't help but wonder if you made a wrong decision by agreeing to Dole's request.
Corruptors suddenly appeared on the outskirts of Eastside, near the Rust. The Public Security Bureau decided to engage them to stop their advance.

The Public Security Bureau, with the help of the anti-Mania base, can handle a few scattered Corruptors using their equipment. Nonetheless, mishaps came about. Several sheriffs had been injured, and you arrived just in time to get the situation under control.

As a thank-you, your old friend Dole offered you a voucher for a free meal at the Public Security Bureau's cafeteria, his expression seemingly saying, "The food here is just as good as the MBCC's, if not better." The voucher allows you to order any dish you want and as many dishes as you like.
You took the voucher. Later, you told Wendy to wait at the main entrance for someone from the MBCC to pick her up and left Nightingale a message saying "Social engagements."
You come to the window and order a few of your usual favorites. Nothing fancy.

You give the voucher to the cafeteria lady. She stares at it for a second before picking up a few freshly baked blueberry tarts and placing them on your tray. No one has ever ordered so little with an all-you-can-eat voucher, she says. She insists you take the tarts, or she'll feel guilty.
You glance at the tarts. They look delicious, each with many blueberries in it and a perfectly golden crust. You thank the cafeteria lady and carry the tray of food to the dining area.

The cafeteria is packed, but oddly enough, the tables near the aisle are mostly unoccupied. You don't see objects placed on them or on the seats around them. The sheriffs seem to be giving them a wide berth.
You place your tray on one of the tables. You're wondering if you should find another table to have your meal at when a sheriff approaches you and sets her tray down next to yours.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Please take a seat.
She invites you to sit, tapping the edge of your tray with the handle of her spoon, as if she owned the table.
You recognize her. She is the sheriff you saved from the Corruptor today.
You glance at the girl's abdomen, which is swathed in bandages, but she seems fine.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: It's... no big deal. I've been through much worse.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Thank you for today anyway.
While talking to you, the girl keeps her hands busy.
She scoops three teaspoons of sugar and one teaspoon of creamer into her drink, and starts stirring it, thirty times clockwise, thirty times counterclockwise.
Then she wipes the table knife and quickly cuts the croissant into six equal parts, which she butters evenly.
Methodically, she readies all the items on her tray for consumption.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Is this some kind of ritual?

choices.text: Is this some kind of ritual?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: This is what the human body needs for dinner. Six hundred calories.
She flattens and folds the empty skim milk carton and lays it neatly aside.
She needs more nutrients. What she is having is more a meal for someone on a diet than for someone who is recovering from injuries.
You push the blueberry tarts toward her.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Not enough? I've got another voucher here. You can use it to get yourself some meat.
The sheriff in front of you keeps silent, shaking her head.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: I don't like that... feeling of not being in control...

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: It's the same with work. I like capturing criminals, but... when it comes to Corruptors...

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: You feel you're not up to it?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: I've seen others successfully defeating Corruptors on TV a few times. Still, I don't know what to do when I actually have to fight them in real life.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: If only I were stronger, more capable.
The sheriff looks dejected.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Don't be so hard on yourself.

choices.text: Don't be so hard on yourself.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: It's normal to feel scared and confused in the face of unknown dangers... I'm no different.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: People like us, we must pluck up our courage and try.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: What if you've tried and failed, over and over? What would you do?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Even if in a dangerous situation like the one we were in today, or even more dangerous?
You give no answer. Telling her not to give up no matter the circumstances wouldn't sit well with you. When you're facing an enemy far stronger than you, refusing to give up could cost your life.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: I put you on the spot, didn't I? Well, you can just connect me to the shackles. That way...

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: Cough...
Her remark catches you off guard; you almost choke. You look around to make sure no one can hear you, gesturing for her to lower her voice.

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: <size=35>Don't discuss the shackles here. It's not something that can be discussed in public. Besides, the shackles are of no use to ordinary people...</size>

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Pfft, I know that.
Finally, a smile lights up her solemn face, as a result of a well-executed prank.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Well...

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Will you come and participate in other operations in the future?

steps.speaker: Player
steps.content: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: Some of the Public Security Bureau's operations involve Sinners.

steps.speaker: Sheriff
steps.content: If you don't, I'll come find you. Think of it as... me returning the favor.

steps.speaker: Option
options: That doesn't sound like something a sheriff would say.

choices.text: That doesn't sound like something a sheriff would say.

steps.content: The setting sun slants through the window, spilling soft golden light over the snow-white sheets and giving a warm feel to the hospital room.
There is a gentle knock on the door. The door opens. The visitor's long shadow precedes her into the room.
There is a nurse inside. The nurse knows the visitor. She gives a nod and leaves the room.
The girl first checks the window. The paper wedged into the crack is still there. She then unpacks the get-well-soon gifts to see if they're bugged.
Only after making sure nothing is amiss does she allow herself to relax. She replaces the slightly wilted jasmine flowers in the vase with fresh ones.
Next to the vase is a framed family photo. The girl studies the slightly faded photo, an encapsulation of the happiness shared by a family of three.
She reaches behind the photo frame, twists something, and removes the object holding the frame upright.
It's a bullet, a handgun bullet.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I have the same dream every day. In the dream, I'm being prodded along toward the edge of a cliff... and then falling off it.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: After I woke up from the dream today, I ate a blueberry tart.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: It was much sweeter than I'd expected, sweeter than anything you've ever made me.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: But it was delicious.
She rises to her feet slowly.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: Mom, I want to try again. I'm a sheriff of the Public Security Bureau now, not a <color=#fb9259>Ghost</color> anymore.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I still have plenty of money left for your treatment... But I must stop associating with those people, or...

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I met the MBCC Chief today. He's amazing.
steps.female_content: I met the MBCC Chief today. She's amazing.

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: If only I could be more like him... the two of you wouldn't have ended up like this.
steps.female_content: If only I could be more like her... the two of you wouldn't have ended up like this.

steps.content: After ending her one-sided conversation, Jane leaves the hospital room. She is walking toward the exit when the nurse from just now hurries up to her, a note in hand.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Miss Jane... Good thing I caught you. A hooded man came in just now and asked to give you this.
Jane takes the note and reads it. As the words on it sink in, the bullet slips out of her grasp.
Ding—
Is there a place she can escape to? Jane doesn't know.
How to put an end to the nightmare? Jane doesn't know.
How to kill that demon? Jane doesn't know.
She only knows that the bullet has fallen onto the floor, bounced a few times, and rolled to the base of the wall.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Miss Jane, Miss Jane... Are you okay?

steps.speaker: Jane
steps.content: I'm fine. I'm fine...

Dear Jane:

Sorry to interrupt your heartwarming reunion with your mother. I found the hospital, though you'd never told me the address.
How is the game of make-believe going? How many criminals have you caught this year? Oh, you must be strapped for cash, if I'm not mistaken. You'll need a cash injection to pay the medical bills and your dad's lawyer, right?

It's about time you came back. We're going to do a major bank job together.

It's more than 37 million DisCoins this time. As usual, see you at the Bank of Eastside.

—Coleman
